claim_text: A third voice heard praying in the closet with them that neither could account for, and a great revival coming to the nation among the youth, seen across Australia, America and Europe, with the devil coming after the youth hard and God coming after them harder, including a youth revival at Church of His Presence.
quote: The devil has come after the youth hard, but I'm coming after them harder
falsify_match: A measurable youth religious movement across those three regions, and one at the named church.
falsify_miss: No such movement. The third voice is offered as corroboration and rests on what he and his wife say they heard.

claim_text: The youth outpouring tied to the youth building the Collinsville church is putting up and to what God will do with the young people in Oklahoma, with his youngest daughter travailing in prayer for the broadcast.
quote: the youth building that the church Collinsville's building
falsify_match: A youth revival centred on that named church building.
falsify_miss: The building opens without one. Naming a specific church under construction is checkable.

claim_text: Certain investments skyrocketing and countries that have been dormant coming up, Cuba among them, alongside the debt and what the stimulus is doing to the American economy, which he says is an adrenaline shot that only lasts a little while.
quote: the fruit of stimulus. I see debt
falsify_match: A short boom followed by a reversal, with Cuban assets rising.
falsify_miss: No boom, or a durable one. He explicitly holds both sides here, which is why the claim cannot fail as stated.

claim_text: The man who takes over from Powell working out a battle plan to save America, and a plan taking shape to eliminate Zelensky, who is seen as a Pinocchio marionette manipulated by Macron and the EU.
quote: How do we eliminate Zelensky? How do we take him out?
falsify_match: Zelensky removed by an arranged plan.
falsify_miss: He remains. The Powell succession was already scheduled and public when this was given.

claim_text: An antichrist spirit and darkness seen trying to overshadow the president on the Sunday, which he says he could not see through until the King arrived that week, and he states there is a demonic covering over the royals while saying he is not calling the King the antichrist.
quote: there is a demonic covering over the royals that is is dark
falsify_match: An identifiable influence from the British monarchy on American policy after the visit.
falsify_miss: No such influence. He says he did not know the visit was coming, which is the priority question; state visits are announced well in advance.

claim_text: Iran's navy described as entirely sunk, a holy war to bring forth the Mahdi, and a season of no bloodshed given in Ukraine which Putin uses to rest his troops and rebuild supplies while holding his cards and waiting to take the whole thing.
quote: I saw a season of no bloodshed for it was like a little short season
falsify_match: A ceasefire used by Russia to rebuild before resuming.
falsify_miss: No ceasefire, or a durable peace. A pause that is then broken is the ordinary shape of this war, which makes it hard to distinguish.

claim_text: Russia taking half of Kyiv and installing a proxy government that is pro-Russia and pro-Ukraine while keeping all the land taken, and the other man mysteriously disappearing, seen looking like Jason Bourne in a beautiful room with cocaine and prostitutes.
quote: I saw them taking half of Kiev
falsify_match: Russian forces holding half of Kyiv with a proxy administration.
falsify_miss: Kyiv stays under Ukrainian control. Half of the capital is a much stronger claim than the eastern territory Russia holds.

claim_text: He says the mountain in Iran will be made to glow in the days ahead but that it will not be America that does it, it will be Israel, using a tactical weapon of a kind never seen before, and that afterwards it cannot be claimed as an American action.
quote: It will be Israel
falsify_match: An Israeli strike on the Iranian mountain site with an unfamiliar weapon.
falsify_miss: No strike, or an American one. Naming which of the two acts is the checkable part, and he stakes it plainly.

claim_text: He reads out a headline about advanced imaging uncovering lost New Testament pages hidden for over eight hundred years, saying he does not know whether it is true but would enjoy reading them.
quote: advanced images uncover lost New Testament pages
falsify_match: Not applicable; a news item read out with an explicit caveat.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though he flags his own uncertainty here, which he does not always do.

claim_text: Prayer for godly spouses to be sent to single believers even if they have to move across America, Australia or Asia, and that they get an Isaac or a Boaz rather than an Ishmael.
quote: They will not get an Ishmael
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Words of knowledge over the broadcast about pain and infection drying up, and about decaying gums and loose teeth being healed, with sufferers named as being in Africa, South America and Asia.
quote: There's many of you that have teeth problems
falsify_match: Verified dental healings reported back from those regions.
falsify_miss: No verification is sought or offered. Words of knowledge to an audience of thousands will always find someone who fits.

claim_text: He points to Iraq electing a Kurdish president in the fallout of the Iran war as the fulfilment of what he was shown: those influencing being exterminated, a new leader rising, the prince losing his grip, and the breadbasket of the world and Babylon rising as an end time sign.
quote: You'll see this the Babylon rise. Watch this end time signs
falsify_match: The earlier word naming a leadership change in Iraq before it happened.
falsify_miss: The earlier word names a breadbasket and a Babylon rather than an election. He is fitting a same-day news item to a general word.

claim_text: Iraq becoming like Saudi Arabia financially with oil, coming up out of nowhere, with the Islamic groupings all becoming friends as an Islamic Brotherhood, and Iran thrown to the side as the unwanted one, a phrase he stops to correct himself over.
quote: you'll see them become the Islamic Brotherhood
falsify_match: A formal alignment of Islamic states with Iraq prospering and Iran excluded.
falsify_miss: No such alignment. He interrupts himself twice to apologise for the stepchild wording, which is worth recording.

claim_text: Bees rising out of the land among flowers and circling a woman's head in Minnesota, read against the reported nine billion dollars or more of fraud there, which he calls a major crack in the foundation and credits to prayer from Minnesota and from Living Word.
quote: the bees are coming up out of the land and they're circling
falsify_match: Fraud findings in Minnesota reaching nine billion, with prosecutions following.
falsify_miss: The figure is scaled back or unproven. The nine billion is a federal speculation quoted in the clip he is watching, not a figure he gives.

claim_text: An agreement coming, with Ezekiel 38 and 39 and the hook in the jaw seen in Russia talking to Iran now, and the timeline described as rice paper thin, with a viewer pointing out that the black diamonds he saw in Putin's hand are not right.
quote: We are on a rice paper thin in the timeline
falsify_match: A Russia and Iran pact leading to the coalition war on Israel.
falsify_miss: Russia and Iran already signed a strategic partnership in January 2025, so meetings between them are the baseline rather than a sign.

claim_text: Teaching to build faith on small things first, with a vision of people around tables who had nothing holding hands, and pots filling with beans, cornbread and potatoes within seconds when they said grace.
quote: I saw pots of food fill up with all these food
falsify_match: Documented multiplication of food.
falsify_miss: No such documentation. He notes others have had the same kind of vision, which he offers as support.

claim_text: The George Müller example used to argue that believing for a million becomes as easy as believing for five dollars once faith has been built up, with faith and patience and works required.
quote: just as easy to believe for $5 as what it was for a million
falsify_match: Not applicable; instruction.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: A personal account of being told to pay for a stranger's trip to Israel that she had put on a credit card, with his wife hearing the same at the same moment, and of giving an amount that was a lot of money to them.
quote: the Lord spoke to me the exact same thing at the exact same time
falsify_match: Not applicable; a personal account.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though the simultaneous confirmation between him and his wife is the pattern he uses to validate promptings.

claim_text: The revival in Cuba will be among the youth, a stirring that spreads throughout Asia, with youth revivals also in Australia and Canada.
quote: THE REVIVAL THAT WILL happen in Cuba will be with youth
falsify_match: A youth religious movement in Cuba spreading to Asia.
falsify_miss: No such movement. Cuba is the specific part, since he has named it repeatedly for other reasons.

claim_text: The president seen paddling a boat in a pressed suit looking cartoonish while rockets shoot out at Cuba, with Cuba on the horizon looking toxic and its economy booming but poisoned, which he acknowledges seems to contradict his own better-for-a-season visions.
quote: Cuba looked very toxic
falsify_match: American military action against Cuba alongside a Cuban economic opening.
falsify_miss: Neither. He raises the contradiction with his own earlier material himself, which is unusual and worth keeping.

claim_text: A genetically modified AI disease created in a Chinese laboratory by splicing part of COVID with the genetic makeup of old diseases, made more effective against people on diabetic and heart medicine, with no vaccination for it, which he says they will release.
quote: This is a genetic AI disease that's created in a laboratory
falsify_match: An engineered pathogen with a documented Chinese laboratory origin and a drug-interaction design.
falsify_miss: No such pathogen. Splicing to target people on particular medications is not a mechanism that corresponds to how either drugs or viruses work.

claim_text: Rats rather than bats injected and released in Europe with red eyes, and as the virus spreads the face of each country fades away, which he compares to the photograph fading in Back to the Future.
quote: I saw them injecting rats and they released them in Europe
falsify_match: A deliberate release of infected rodents in Europe.
falsify_miss: No such release. He corrects bats to rats himself, saying the Lord told him it is rats.

claim_text: Boats coming from China rusting and disintegrating in acid with crypto and dollar signs floating in it, seen as the trade wars, with the president holding cards while floating in the same acid.
quote: I saw the boats beginning to disintegrate in the acid
falsify_match: A collapse in Chinese-American shipping trade alongside a currency crisis.
falsify_miss: Trade continues. The acid is his image for the state of the economy rather than a described event.

claim_text: Putin waiting out the presidential term to take all of Ukraine, and the 25th, 13th and First Amendments seen, with a black widow doubled then tripled in size wrapping the First Amendment, and the president reading a newspaper showing zero slash zero and an income tax plan whose fine print is too small to read.
quote: it had zero slashzero and it said income tax plan
falsify_match: An income tax proposal reducing rates to zero, and a First Amendment restriction.
falsify_miss: Neither. The fine print being unreadable removes the detail that would have made this checkable, which he states as part of the vision.

claim_text: A run of refinery explosions listed by date across Australia, Pakistan, Russia, India, Texas, Romania and Erbil in a single month, including one he says was struck by lightning the previous night, set against a national debt of over forty trillion.
quote: a major refinery mysteriously blew up because lightning hit it
falsify_match: A coordinated campaign against refineries established.
falsify_miss: Refinery fires occur regularly worldwide and several of the listed ones have published causes. He is assembling a list after the fact rather than predicting it.

claim_text: A major plan coming out in Venezuela, the economy stimulated with drill baby drill and printing, and major refineries coming up on the Gaza with major oil in the Mediterranean.
quote: I saw a major refineries coming up on the Gaza
falsify_match: Refinery construction on the Gaza coast.
falsify_miss: None is built. Gaza has no refining capacity and the offshore field is undeveloped, so this requires both to change.

claim_text: A retrospective on the COVID shutdowns, the two weeks that became months, drive-through services with car horns, and a minister jailed for holding church anyway, with a remark that he sees another one coming.
quote: I um I see another one coming
falsify_match: Another shutdown with churches closed.
falsify_miss: No shutdown. The recollection is accurate; the forward half is a half sentence.

claim_text: He treats the Oklahoma Sooners name and the schooner wagon on their flag as confirmation of the word to watch South Korea and Japan, saying it is happening just as given and that accuracy matters.
quote: Remember the Lord said, Watch South Korea. Watch Japan
falsify_match: South Korea and Japan moving first on the thing he named, before America.
falsify_miss: They do not. The Sooners wordplay is being read back onto the word as its confirmation, which is a different thing from the event occurring.

claim_text: Churches with the capacity for the end time harvest that have said no when asked, with the tugging at hearts continuing, and one seen in South America with a sea of Spanish-speaking people and a dark-haired man with a moustache leading it.
quote: I see a a a sea of of of Spanish people
falsify_match: A named South American church becoming a harvest centre.
falsify_miss: None does. The conditional means refusal by the churches explains any absence.

claim_text: Glory spots with satellite churches spreading off one main church, with Tennessee highlighted toward Memphis and then Nashville named instead, and others adding their supply.
quote: There'll be satellite churches off the one church
falsify_match: A Tennessee church planting satellites as a revival centre.
falsify_miss: None does. He corrects Memphis to Nashville mid-sentence, which is the identification being assembled.

claim_text: The same satellite church material repeated with Tennessee, Memphis and Nashville named again.
quote: Tennessee's highlighted right there
falsify_match: As above.
falsify_miss: As above; this is the same passage repeated in the stream.

claim_text: Something about Russia and Iran when they met, with a storm seen brewing there.
quote: There's something here trying to brew
falsify_match: A Russia and Iran agreement with military consequences.
falsify_miss: Nothing follows. No content is given beyond the impression.

claim_text: The taking happening at night in America with lightning shooting all over the sky and no thunder, everyone aged fifteen and younger gone, mothers frantically searching, and a woman screaming that the aliens came and got them.
quote: from the children that were age of 15 and younger were all gone
falsify_match: Not checkable in advance by design.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. The age of fifteen is the specific detail and it recurs across tellings.

claim_text: The antichrist coming on the scene quickly after the disappearance, with every leader meeting at a table in Berlin, and a man getting out of a Rolls-Royce in a black and white cashmere suit with olive skin and a tailored black beard, from whom peace flows hypnotically as he speaks.
quote: as he spoke, peace flowed out of him
falsify_match: A summit of world leaders in Berlin around a single new figure.
falsify_miss: No such summit. The olive skin and tailored beard here match the Saudi figure he names elsewhere, which makes the two identifications consistent.

claim_text: He points to a news report of devices in the back of a car knocking out mobile service and even emergency calls, tens of thousands of phones hit and over thirteen million disruptions with three men charged, as the fulfilment of what he saw, adding that they are making them in cars now rather than only in a train.
quote: They're making them in the car
falsify_match: The earlier word naming a vehicle-mounted device before the case broke.
falsify_miss: The earlier word names a train and something massive inside it, and he says so here while claiming the car version as the same thing.

claim_text: The device seen in an SUV in Toronto, with Atlanta named as where he said it would be, entry over the northern border from Canada through Michigan rather than only Mexico, and more of them in Chicago and Seattle.
quote: There's one in Chicago. There's one in Seattle, remember?
falsify_match: Similar devices found in Chicago and Seattle.
falsify_miss: None found. Chicago and Seattle are the forward half of this and are still open.

claim_text: He says the Lord told him they are getting ready for a red dawn experience and that a D-Day is coming to the nation, tied to the men who came in through Michigan.
quote: They're getting ready for a red dawn experience in your nation
falsify_match: A coordinated armed action inside America.
falsify_miss: No such action. Red dawn and D-Day are both images rather than described events.

claim_text: Men saying they will make their own baby out of themselves without needing a woman and growing it in an incubator, which he calls playing God, and he declines to play a clip from a channel with three million subscribers.
quote: I'm going to make my own baby for me out of me
falsify_match: A child gestated entirely outside a body from a single person's genetic material.
falsify_miss: No such child. He is reacting to material already circulating on other channels, which he says on air.

claim_text: A stimulus of about two thousand five hundred dollars heard again, to boost morale in the Republican party, for people making less than one hundred and fifty thousand.
quote: it's for people making less than 150
falsify_match: A payment of about that size with an income threshold near that figure.
falsify_miss: No such payment, or different numbers. Two figures given together makes this one of the more checkable economic claims in the corpus.

claim_text: Cuba seen again with cruise ships and the word royal, tied to the economy.
quote: I see cruise ships. I see royal
falsify_match: Cruise lines returning to Cuban ports.
falsify_miss: American cruise calls to Cuba have been prohibited since 2019, so this requires a policy reversal first.

claim_text: A golden goose with lines running out of it to Africa, South America and other parts of the world like the travel map in Indiana Jones, with the president looking at it and the goose and a soccer ball reflected in his eye.
quote: there is uh lines coming out and they're going to each like Africa
falsify_match: An American programme extending capital into Africa and South America.
falsify_miss: None appears. The soccer ball alongside is unexplained, and the World Cup falls in this period.

claim_text: Chinese barges and a massive red, black and white ship carrying trade to America, everything floating in green acid sludge, with a huge needle in it of the kind used on a horse, and he says none of it is good.
quote: It has a huge needle on it
falsify_match: A trade or currency crisis in Chinese-American shipping.
falsify_miss: Trade continues. The red, black and white ship matches the boat he has described since 2025, which links the two threads.

claim_text: Prayer for named older ministers and figures, Perry Stone, John, Mike Lindell and the president, for blood flow and long life, with a word that God will use the Tennessee man in the days ahead and a young man will come up beside him to help.
quote: I'm going to use him in Tennessee in these days ahead
falsify_match: A named successor emerging beside Perry Stone.
falsify_miss: None emerges. He says he told viewers this last year, which puts a record on it.

claim_text: Glory spots that people will crawl out of, one at Cleveland in Tennessee where Harvest Church is, and one at Church of His Presence with John Kilpatrick, in whom he sees a stirring and cultivation like whipping cream.
quote: They're glory spots again
falsify_match: Sustained revival at those two named churches.
falsify_miss: Neither. Naming two specific congregations and their pastors is checkable, unlike the general revival material.

claim_text: A great red wave and a great move of God in California, and he points to Perry Stone publicly asking for prayer that same day as evidence the Lord had put the man on his heart, saying it is not coincidence.
quote: when he came public today asking for prayer
falsify_match: A prior recording naming the man before the request became public.
falsify_miss: No such recording is produced here, though he says he gave it on the broadcast last year, which could be checked against the corpus.
